map.单价 − 单位变动成本 使用指南: Unit Price Minus Unit Variable Cost User Guide
map.单位边际贡献 = 单价 − 单位变动成本: Unit contribution margin = unit price - unit variable cost
map.单位边际贡献=单价−单位变动成本，用于本量利与短期决策；毛利=收入−营业成本，含: Unit contribution margin = unit price - unit variable cost, used for cost-volume-profit analysis and short-term decisions; gross profit = revenue - cost of goods sold, which includes allocated fixed manufacturing overhead and is a broader measure.
map.单位边际贡献和毛利有什么区别？: What is the difference between unit contribution margin and gross profit?
map.单品盈利性分析，判断某产品是否值得继续生产或保留。: Product-level profitability analysis to decide whether a product is worth keeping in production.
map.多产品组合优化时，优先排产高单位边际贡献的产品。: When optimizing a multi-product mix, schedule the products with high unit contribution margin first.
map.测算降价空间：在仍为正边际贡献范围内可短期促销清库存。: Price reduction room: as long as the contribution margin is still positive you can run a short promotion to clear stock.
map.由应付账款与营业成本求付款天数: Days payable from accounts payable and cost of goods sold
map.由应收账款与营收求收款天数: Days sales outstanding from accounts receivable and revenue
map.由经营现金流与债务偿付额求保障倍数: Interest coverage ratio from operating cash flow and debt service
map.输入产品单价与单位变动成本，计算单位边际贡献与边际贡献率，辅助判断是否覆盖固定成: Enter the product unit price and unit variable cost to compute the unit contribution margin and the contribution margin ratio, which helps judge whether fixed costs are covered and whether the product is profitable; it suits cost-volume-profit analysis and product profitability evaluation.
map.边际贡献为负为什么要停产？: Why stop production when the contribution margin is negative?
map.边际贡献为负意味着每卖一件多亏一件的变动成本，停产可止损；但若能覆盖部分固定成本: A negative contribution margin means every extra unit sold loses that much variable cost, so stopping stops the bleeding; but if part of the fixed cost can still be covered, producing in the short term loses less than stopping.
map.：某产品售价 80 元、单位变动成本 50 元，单位边际贡献=80−50=30: : a product with a price of 80 CNY and a unit variable cost of 50 CNY has a unit contribution margin of 80-50 = 30 CNY; with a monthly fixed cost of 30,000 CNY, 1000 units must be sold to cover the fixed cost and start earning profit.
